system.description:
You have intimate knowledge of the workings of Starships and other Vehicles and can keep them running no matter what.

Prerequisite: Mon Calamari

Effect: You need spend only two Swift Actions to move a Vehicle you occupy +1 step on the Condition Track. In addition, you automatically succeed on Mechanics checks to Reroute Power.

Normal: It takes three Swift Actions to use the Reroute Power Action.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
